diagnosis: Three defects in the first correction: (1) Garland beads live inside <g fill='#d4a820'/> etc. groups that are direct children of artwork_g — the old script only clipped bare <circle> children, so those garland groups were placed in 'others' and their beads remained unclipped outside the foliage; additionally the fairy light circles that ARE direct children were all moved to a clipped lights group but that group was appended after the ornament children, changing z-order. Fix: identify garland <g> nodes by their gold fill colours and apply clip-path='url(#treeClip)' directly to those groups; apply the same clip to a wrapper for the direct fairy-light circles, identified by their actual light colours (#ff4040/#ff3030/#ffe040/#60a0ff/#40e060) rather than by radius, so the gold spire-tip circle (#ffe8a0, r=4) is NOT clipped. (2) The spire tip circle cx=320 cy=44 r=4 fill=#ffe8a0 was caught by the r<=5 rule and clipped away. Fix: use colour-based identification for lights, explicitly excluding #ffe8a0 and any circle above y<80. (3) feMorphology dilate produces square corner protrusions because it is a rectangular dilation. Fix: replace the filter-based outline with a stroke-based outline — collect all foliage tier paths, stand polygon/rect, and trunk rect geometry, render them in a background group with fill='#fffef5' and stroke='#fffef5' stroke-width='14' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round', which produces the same 7-unit border on all sides with smooth rounded joins that follow the actual vector silhouette. No bitmaps, no external references, all editable vectors.
